from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=160)
threadpool_limits(limits=4)

def spectrum(a):
    s = np.linalg.svd(a.astype(np.float64), compute_uv=False)
    e = s * s
    p = e / max(e.sum(), 1e-30)
    r90 = int(np.searchsorted(np.cumsum(p), 0.9) + 1)
    erank = np.exp(-np.sum(p * np.log(np.maximum(p, 1e-30))))
    return s, r90, erank

def centered_columns(a):
    return a - a.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)

print("All diagnostics below are weight-only linear algebra; no network evaluations.")
print("Shapes:", {k: v.shape for k, v in sorted(W.items())})

for l in range(4):

        print(name, "mean/std/norm =", np.round([a.mean(), a.std(), np.linalg.norm(a)], 5),
              "quantiles =", np.round(np.quantile(a, [0, .1, .5, .9, 1]), 5))
    for name in ("W_q", "W_k", "W_v", "W_o", "W_fc", "W_proj"):
        a = W[f"{name}.{l}"].astype(np.float64)
        s, r90, erank = spectrum(a)
        print(name, "Frob=%.4f std=%.5f r90=%d effective_rank=%.1f top8=%s" %

    beta = W[f"ln1_b.{l}"].astype(np.float64)

        vr = W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl].astype(np.float64)
        o = W[f"W_o.{l}"][:, sl].astype(np.float64)
        # Fixed matrix coefficients induced by LN's affine parameters,
        # with the constant residual direction projected out.
        q = centered_columns(qr * gamma)
        k = centered_columns(kr * gamma)
        v = centered_columns(vr * gamma)
        A = q.T @ k / 8.0

        sb, rb, eb = spectrum(B)
        na, nb = np.linalg.norm(A), np.linalg.norm(B)

               np.linalg.norm(key_bias)/max(na, 1e-30),
               nb, rb, eb, np.sum(B*B.T)/max(nb**2, 1e-30),
               np.trace(B)/max(nb, 1e-30)))
        print("    raw Q/K/V/O norms =", np.round(
            [np.linalg.norm(z) for z in (qr, kr, vr, o)], 4),
            "QK top6 =", np.round(sa[:6], 4),
            "OV top6 =", np.round(sb[:6], 4))

    fc = W[f"W_fc.{l}"].astype(np.float64)
    proj = W[f"W_proj.{l}"].astype(np.float64)
    g2 = W[f"ln2_w.{l}"].astype(np.float64)
    b2 = W[f"ln2_b.{l}"].astype(np.float64)
    f = centered_columns(fc * g2)
    dots = np.sum(f * proj.T, axis=1)
    cos = dots / np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(f, axis=1) *
                           np.linalg.norm(proj, axis=0), 1e-30)
    biases = fc @ b2
    print("MLP input/output-neuron cosine quantiles:",
          np.round(np.quantile(cos, [0, .1, .25, .5, .75, .9, 1]), 4))
    print("MLP affine-bias coefficient quantiles:",

import numpy as np
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(limits=4)
np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=160)

def cent(a):
    return a - a.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)

def norm(a):
    return np.linalg.norm(a)

def cos(a, b):
    return np.sum(a*b) / max(norm(a)*norm(b), 1e-30)

A, B, kb = {}, {}, {}
for l in range(4):
    g = W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
    b = W[f"ln1_b.{l}"].astype(float)
    for j in range(6):
        s = slice(j*64, (j+1)*64)
        q0 = W[f"W_q.{l}"][s].astype(float)
        k0 = W[f"W_k.{l}"][s].astype(float)
        q, k = cent(q0*g), cent(k0*g)
        v = cent(W[f"W_v.{l}"][s].astype(float)*g)
        o = W[f"W_o.{l}"][:, s].astype(float)
        A[l,j] = q.T @ k / 8
        B[l,j] = o @ v
        kb[l,j] = (q0 @ b) @ k / 8

# Candidate shared character-reading subspace, derived only from value weights.
_, ss, vt = np.linalg.svd(np.vstack([B[0,1], B[0,5]]), full_matrices=False)
C = vt[:27].T
print("Joint L0H1/L0H5 OV input singular values:", ss[:40])
print("\nL0 QK energy in candidate character subspace (query/key/both); OV input energy there")
for j in range(6):
    a, b = A[0,j], B[0,j]
    print("L0H%d" % j,
          np.round([norm(C.T@a)**2/norm(a)**2,
                    norm(a@C)**2/norm(a)**2,
                    norm(C.T@a@C)**2/norm(a)**2,
                    norm(b@C)**2/norm(b)**2], 4))

print("\nL0 pairwise QK Frobenius cosine")
print(np.array([[cos(A[0,i], A[0,j]) for j in range(6)] for i in range(6)]))
print("L0 pairwise OV Frobenius cosine")
print(np.array([[cos(B[0,i], B[0,j]) for j in range(6)] for i in range(6)]))

print("\nL1 pairwise QK cosine")
print(np.array([[cos(A[1,i], A[1,j]) for j in range(6)] for i in range(6)]))
print("L1 key-bias cosine")
print(np.array([[cos(kb[1,i], kb[1,j]) for j in range(6)] for i in range(6)]))

print("\nPotential key-composition circuits A_lh @ B_previous.")
print("Each entry: previous_head, trace/F, symmetric_cosine, composition_strength.")
print("Positive trace and symmetry are only circuit clues, not measured attention.")
for l in range(1,4):
    for j in range(6):
        entries = []
        for m in range(l):
            for i in range(6):
                t = A[l,j] @ B[m,i]
                nt = norm(t)
                tr = np.trace(t)/max(nt, 1e-30)
                sy = cos(t, t.T)
                strength = np.sqrt(384)*nt/max(norm(A[l,j])*norm(B[m,i]), 1e-30)
                entries.append((tr, m, i, sy, strength))
        entries.sort(reverse=True)
        best = ["L%dH%d %.3f %.3f %.2f" % (m,i,tr,sy,strength)
                for tr,m,i,sy,strength in entries[:5]]
        print("L%dH%d:" % (l,j), "; ".join(best))

print("\nL0 character-subspace key-composition scores for all later heads")
print("Columns: upstream L0H0..H5; trace(C.T @ A @ B @ C) / Frobenius")
for l in range(1,4):
    for j in range(6):
        vals = []
        for i in range(6):
            t = C.T @ A[l,j] @ B[0,i] @ C
            vals.append(np.trace(t)/max(norm(t), 1e-30))
        print("L%dH%d" % (l,j), np.round(vals, 3))

print("\nL0 QK split between symmetric and skew-symmetric parts")
for j in range(6):
    a = A[0,j]
    ev = np.linalg.eigvalsh((a+a.T)/2)
    print("L0H%d sym_extremes =" % j, np.r_[ev[:5], ev[-5:]],
          "skew_energy=%.4f" % (norm((a-a.T)/2)**2/norm(a)**2))

print("\nL1 key-bias alignment to L0 OV output spaces (top two directions)")
for i in range(6):
    u, s, _ = np.linalg.svd(B[0,i], full_matrices=False)
    vals = [norm(u[:,:2].T@kb[1,j])**2/max(norm(kb[1,j])**2, 1e-30)
            for j in range(6)]
    print("L0H%d output:" % i, np.round(vals, 4))

import numpy as np
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(limits=4)

def cent(a):
    return a - a.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)

def norm(a):

A, B = {}, {}
for l in range(4):
    g = W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
    for j in range(6):
        sl = slice(64*j, 64*(j+1))
        q = cent(W[f"W_q.{l}"][sl].astype(float)*g)
        k = cent(W[f"W_k.{l}"][sl].astype(float)*g)
        v = cent(W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl].astype(float)*g)
        A[l,j] = q.T @ k / 8
        B[l,j] = W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,sl].astype(float) @ v

_, _, vt = np.linalg.svd(np.vstack([B[0,1], B[0,5]]), full_matrices=False)
C = vt[:27].T

print("Final MLP output singular spectrum, first 60:")
print(np.linalg.svd(W["W_proj.3"].astype(float), compute_uv=False)[:60])
print("\nL0 OV singular spectra, first 32:")
for j in range(6):
    print("L0H%d" % j, np.linalg.svd(B[0,j], compute_uv=False)[:32])

# Compare fixed coefficient blocks on weight-derived subspaces.
S = [C, B[0,5]@C, B[0,1]@C]
names = ["current", "via_L0H5", "via_L0H1"]
print("\nMatching-index matrices: tr(S_query.T A S_key) / Frobenius.")
print("Rows/columns:", names)
for l in range(1,4):
    for j in range(6):
        t = np.array([[np.trace(x.T@A[l,j]@y)/max(norm(x.T@A[l,j]@y), 1e-30)
                       for y in S] for x in S])
        print("L%dH%d" % (l,j), np.round(t,3).tolist())

# The following is a covariance of MLP weight rows, not an MLP evaluation.
f = cent(W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"].astype(float))
f0 = f @ C
f5 = f @ B[0,5] @ C
f1 = f @ B[0,1] @ C

def invsqrt_psd(a, reg=1e-3):
    ev, u = np.linalg.eigh(a)
    return (u * (1/np.sqrt(np.maximum(ev, reg*ev.max())))) @ u.T

print("\nL0 MLP weight-row cross-association.")
for name, other in [("H5",f5),("H1",f1)]:
    x = f0 - f0.mean(axis=0)
    y = other - other.mean(axis=0)
    xx, yy = x.T@x, y.T@y
    pooled = invsqrt_psd((xx+yy)/2)
    cross = pooled @ (x.T@y) @ pooled
    sym = (cross+cross.T)/2
    ev = np.linalg.eigvalsh(sym)
    cc = invsqrt_psd(xx) @ (x.T@y) @ invsqrt_psd(yy)
    print(name, "symmetric eigenvalues:", ev)
    print(name, "canonical correlations:", np.linalg.svd(cc,compute_uv=False))

print("\nStrength of L0 output subspaces in subsequent QK coefficients.")
print("For each head: query/key energy fractions in each top-two L0 output space.")
spaces = [np.linalg.svd(B[0,i],full_matrices=False)[0][:,:2] for i in (0,4)]
for l in range(1,4):

        print("L%dH%d H0=(%.3f,%.3f) H4=(%.3f,%.3f)" %

print("\nLargest L0 LN1 gains and corresponding matrix-column energies:")
g = W["ln1_w.0"].astype(float)
ix = np.argsort(g)[-16:][::-1]
for i in ix:

import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.decomposition import FastICA
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(limits=4)
np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True, linewidth=180)

def cent(a):
    return a-a.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)

g = W["ln1_w.0"].astype(float)
B = []
for j in range(6):
    sl = slice(64*j,64*(j+1))
    v = cent(W["W_v.0"][sl].astype(float)*g)
    B.append(W["W_o.0"][:,sl].astype(float)@v)

_, _, vt = np.linalg.svd(np.vstack([B[1],B[5]]),full_matrices=False)
C = vt[:27].T
f = cent(W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"].astype(float))
X = [f@C, f@B[5]@C, f@B[1]@C]

print("Principal-angle cosines between L0H1/H5 top-27 value-input spaces:")
r1 = np.linalg.svd(B[1],full_matrices=False)[2][:27].T
r5 = np.linalg.svd(B[5],full_matrices=False)[2][:27].T
print(np.linalg.svd(r1.T@r5,compute_uv=False))

# Fit only to actual weight rows and their linear-algebra compositions.
# No synthetic residual inputs or nonlinear network operations are used.
joint = np.vstack([x/np.linalg.norm(x)*np.sqrt(x.size) for x in X])
mu = joint.mean(axis=0)
ev, u = np.linalg.eigh(np.cov(joint,rowvar=False))
whitener = (u*(1/np.sqrt(np.maximum(ev,ev.max()*1e-3))))@u.T
Z = (joint-mu)@whitener
Zn = Z/np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(Z,axis=1,keepdims=True),1e-12)
km = KMeans(n_clusters=28,n_init=15,random_state=42).fit(Zn)
labels = km.labels_.reshape(3,1536)
centers = km.cluster_centers_
centers /= np.linalg.norm(centers,axis=1,keepdims=True)
assigned_cos = np.sum(Zn*centers[km.labels_],axis=1).reshape(3,1536)

print("\nWeight-row clustering quality, current / via H5 / via H1:")
for i in range(3):
    print(i,"cosine quantiles",np.quantile(assigned_cos[i],[.1,.25,.5,.75,.9]),
          "cluster counts",np.bincount(labels[i],minlength=28))
print("Cluster-center cosine quantiles:",
      np.quantile((centers@centers.T)[np.triu_indices(28,1)],[0,.1,.5,.9,1]))

# Class-pair counts among neurons with reasonably clear weight directions.
for idx in (1,2):
    tab = np.zeros((28,28),dtype=int)
    mask = (assigned_cos[0]>.55)&(assigned_cos[idx]>.55)
    np.add.at(tab,(labels[0,mask],labels[idx,mask]),1)
    print("\nCurrent versus upstream index",idx,"clear-neuron count",mask.sum())
    print("Diagonal counts:",np.diag(tab))
    pairs = sorted([(tab[i,j],i,j) for i in range(28) for j in range(28)],reverse=True)[:35]
    print("Largest (count,current_cluster,upstream_cluster):",pairs)
    if tab.sum():
        p = tab/tab.sum()
        pi,pj=p.sum(axis=1),p.sum(axis=0)
        denom=pi[:,None]*pj[None,:]
        mi=np.sum(p[p>0]*np.log(p[p>0]/denom[p>0]))
        print("Pair mutual information %.4f; same-cluster fraction %.4f" %
              (mi,np.trace(p)))

print("\nICA on the same weight-row sample:")
ica = FastICA(n_components=27,whiten="unit-variance",random_state=42,
              max_iter=3000,tol=1e-4)
ic = ica.fit_transform(joint)
kurt = np.mean(ic**4,axis=0)/(np.mean(ic**2,axis=0)**2)-3
print("Iterations:",ica.n_iter_)
print("Sorted component excess kurtoses:",np.sort(kurt)[::-1])

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import polar
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(limits=4)
np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=180)

def cent(a):
    return a-a.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)

g=W["ln1_w.0"].astype(float)
A=[]; B=[]
for j in range(6):
    sl=slice(j*64,(j+1)*64)
    q=cent(W["W_q.0"][sl].astype(float)*g)
    k=cent(W["W_k.0"][sl].astype(float)*g)
    v=cent(W["W_v.0"][sl].astype(float)*g)
    A.append(q.T@k/8)
    B.append(W["W_o.0"][:,sl].astype(float)@v)
_,_,vt=np.linalg.svd(np.vstack([B[1],B[5]]),full_matrices=False)
C=vt[:27].T
P=np.eye(384)-C@C.T

print("Positional-subspace tests: these compare matrix factors, not position inputs.")
a=P@A[5]@P
u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(a,full_matrices=False)
for r in (8,12,16,20,24,32):
    angles=np.linalg.svd(u[:,:r].T@vt[:r].T,compute_uv=False)
    print("L0H5 rank",r,"left/right subspace angle cosines:",angles)

# Use the dominant joint row/column space of L0H5's non-character block.
ev,uu=np.linalg.eigh(a@a.T+a.T@a)
for r in (12,16,20,24,32):
    D=uu[:,-r:]
    a5=D.T@a@D
    metric=(a5@a5.T+a5.T@a5)/2
    e,v=np.linalg.eigh(metric)
    G=(v*(np.maximum(e,e.max()*1e-4)**(-.25)))@v.T
    R,_=polar(G@a5@G)
    eig=np.linalg.eigvals(R)
    print("\nRank",r,"polar-factor eigenphases/pi:",np.sort(np.angle(eig)/np.pi))
    for j in (0,1,2,3):
        aj=G@(D.T@P@A[j]@P@D)@G
        scores=[]
        for power in range(-8,9):
            rp=np.linalg.matrix_power(R,power)
            c=np.sum(aj*rp)/(np.linalg.norm(aj)*np.linalg.norm(rp))
            scores.append((c,power))
        scores.sort(reverse=True)
        print("H%d top (matrix cosine, relative power):" % j,
              [(round(c,4),p) for c,p in scores[:5]])

# Redo clustering with view-specific centering and bounded row magnitudes,
# to distinguish token structure from differences in weight scales/means.
f=cent(W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"].astype(float))
xs=[f@C,f@B[5]@C,f@B[1]@C]
zs=[]
for x in xs:
    x=x-x.mean(axis=0)
    norms=np.linalg.norm(x,axis=1)
    x=x/np.maximum(norms[:,None],np.quantile(norms,.25))
    zs.append(x)
joint=np.vstack(zs)
e,v=np.linalg.eigh(joint.T@joint)
wh=(v*(np.maximum(e,e.max()*1e-3)**(-.5)))@v.T
z=joint@wh
z/=np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(z,axis=1,keepdims=True),1e-12)
km=KMeans(n_clusters=28,n_init=15,random_state=7).fit(z)
ct=km.cluster_centers_
ct/=np.linalg.norm(ct,axis=1,keepdims=True)
lab=km.labels_.reshape(3,-1)
sim=np.sum(z*ct[km.labels_],axis=1).reshape(3,-1)
print("\nView-centered weight-row clusters:")
for i in range(3):
    print("view",i,"cosine quantiles",np.quantile(sim[i],[.1,.5,.9]),
          "counts",np.bincount(lab[i],minlength=28))
for i in (1,2):
    mask=(sim[0]>.5)&(sim[i]>.5)
    tab=np.zeros((28,28),dtype=int)
    np.add.at(tab,(lab[0,mask],lab[i,mask]),1)
    print("view",i,"clear rows",mask.sum(),"same-cluster fraction",
          np.trace(tab)/max(tab.sum(),1))
    print("largest pairs",sorted([(tab[a,b],a,b) for a in range(28) for b in range(28)],reverse=True)[:20])

import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(limits=4)
np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=180)

def cent(a):
    return a-a.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
def norm(a):
    return np.linalg.norm(a)

B={}
for l in (0,3):
    g=W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
    for j in range(6):
        sl=slice(j*64,(j+1)*64)
        B[l,j]=W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,sl].astype(float) @ cent(W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl].astype(float)*g)

_,_,vt=np.linalg.svd(np.vstack([B[0,1],B[0,5]]),full_matrices=False)
C=vt[:27].T
P3=W["W_proj.3"].astype(float)
T=np.linalg.svd(P3,full_matrices=False)[0][:,:27]
D=T.T@(B[3,1]+B[3,5])@C
print("Candidate shared copying-map singular values:")
print(np.linalg.svd(D,compute_uv=False))

# Cluster the final MLP's actual output-weight columns after whitening.
# This is a weight dictionary, not reconstructed text or a network run.
Y=(T.T@P3).T
mean=Y.mean(axis=0)
Yc=Y-mean
ev,u=np.linalg.eigh(Yc.T@Yc/len(Yc))
wh=(u*(1/np.sqrt(np.maximum(ev,ev.max()*1e-5))))@u.T
unwh=(u*np.sqrt(np.maximum(ev,ev.max()*1e-5)))@u.T
Z=Yc@wh
Zn=Z/np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(Z,axis=1,keepdims=True),1e-12)

saved=None
print("\nOutput-weight dictionary fits:")
for k in (20,24,28,32):
    km=KMeans(n_clusters=k,n_init=15,random_state=100+k).fit(Zn)
    cc=km.cluster_centers_
    radii=np.linalg.norm(cc,axis=1)
    unit=cc/np.maximum(radii[:,None],1e-12)
    assigned=np.sum(Zn*unit[km.labels_],axis=1)
    sil=silhouette_score(Zn,km.labels_,sample_size=1000,random_state=0)
    counts=np.bincount(km.labels_,minlength=k)
    print("k",k,"silhouette",round(sil,4),
          "assignment-cosine quantiles",np.quantile(assigned,[.1,.5,.9]),
          "sorted counts",np.sort(counts)[::-1])
    if k==28:
        saved=(km,cc,unit,counts,assigned)

km,cc,unit,counts,assigned=saved
print("\n28-cluster center cosine quantiles:",
      np.quantile((unit@unit.T)[np.triu_indices(28,1)],[0,.1,.5,.9,1]))
print("Counts in cluster-index order:",counts)
print("Cluster concentration (mean cosine):",np.linalg.norm(cc,axis=1))

# Relate output-weight dictionary directions to early MLP read coefficients
# through the candidate copying map, entirely by matrix products.
# Regularization avoids amplification of nearly unsupported directions.
ud,sd,vtd=np.linalg.svd(D,full_matrices=False)
ridge=(.12*sd[0])**2
Dinv=(vtd.T*(sd/(sd*sd+ridge)))@ud.T
dictionary=C@Dinv@(cc@unwh).T
dictionary/=np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(dictionary,axis=0,keepdims=True),1e-12)

F=cent(W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"].astype(float))
read=[F@dictionary,F@B[0,5]@dictionary,F@B[0,1]@dictionary]
read=[x/np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(x,axis=1,keepdims=True),1e-12) for x in read]
labels=[np.argmax(x,axis=1) for x in read]
print("\nEarly-MLP weight-coefficient maximum counts in that dictionary:")
for i,lab in enumerate(labels):
    print("view",i,np.bincount(lab,minlength=28))
for i in (1,2):
    tab=np.zeros((28,28),dtype=int)
    np.add.at(tab,(labels[0],labels[i]),1)
    print("view",i,"same-index fraction",np.trace(tab)/tab.sum(),
          "top pairs",sorted([(tab[a,b],a,b) for a in range(28) for b in range(28)],reverse=True)[:20])

print("\nOutput dictionary's approximate rank:")
print(np.linalg.svd(dictionary,compute_uv=False))
